evidence: The causal link (tail-aware belief-to-knee conversion is what makes the forecast pass, fixing the mean-sizing defect) is warranted by a controlled ablation that holds the forecast constant and varies only the conversion: Table cl-triad reactive 1615.5 ms / FAIL, forecast+mean-conversion 1716.6 ms / FAIL, forecast+tail-aware 736.3 ms / PASS. DB confirms: v_capacity_knee riders:fc_lead60 (burst1, forecast_req_scale=8) = 736.25 ms p99 ttft / 6.35 ms itl, matching the PASS row exactly; v_pool_latency a11:burst1_reactive_L60 = 1615.5 ms ttft / 125.3 itl matches the reactive FAIL. The belief-to-knee mechanism is derived (replicas scaled by r_hat/r_tail, r_hat=10.07 req/s, r_tail=1.62) not tuned, and v_capacity_knee shows the pass/fail boolean flipping exactly at the scale boundary on both windows (burst1: scale 6.22 passes, 4.64 fails; burst4: 7.0 passes, 6.22 fails). Reactive fails across all leads (60/120/300s: 1615/1612/1586 ms), so the mean-sizing defect is shared by every reactive config tested. The 'held cursor' framing (fixed per-tick forecast sample, so lead-insensitivity is a conversion property not anticipation) is a design fact and the thesis explicitly hedges it as 'best read as a synthetic sampled-signal experiment'. Mechanism isolated by holding forecast constant; not a mere observational correlation.
